IRON YARD — owner-authorized one-shot PUBLIC Roblox update, 12 November 2026.

The owner requested continued execution of roadmap V3 on the EXISTING
public IRON YARD Roblox experience, not a separate private alpha.
This single release includes squash-merged PR #44:
c66691101e496a6b6411306e94ee9d9189b1c032.

Fix: after the LAST participant disconnects, the server must release
any duel preparation anchors, clear the duel combat gate, discard the
participant references and finished-result snapshot, restore the public
lobby to WAITING / FFA and clear all replicated duel scores and podium.
Prior code could retain stale DUEL mode across an empty server and
mislead the next player before a new FFA round. A true one-survivor
forfeit still follows its original server-authoritative scoring rule.

New pure Luau regression tests cover empty FFA/DUEL prep/live/results,
stale mode, remaining participant and idempotent waiting. The server
source integration contract verifies the empty-lobby guard runs BEFORE
the forfeit logic and all replicated states are reset.

The complete Luau compiler, executable suite, Python contracts and
Rojo build are GREEN on PR/push and on merged main. Require fresh
full green CI of this exact authorization commit before dispatch.
The existing public publisher independently verifies the real creator,
PUBLIC universe, original root place, and exact SHA. Do not publish
another place, private experience, or invent runtime/playtest claims.
No private tokens or IDs are included here.
